requirement_text.REQ-124: MOB-2 (docs/mobile/requirements.md) needs GET /tenant-config to return { realm_url, locales, default_locale, branding, environment_kind } WITHOUT a bearer token: the mobile app calls it to discover which realm to authenticate against, so by definition it has no token yet. Verified against lib/ on 2026-08-21, this is two gaps, not one: (a) Letflow.Routers.TenantConfig is a stub whose routes land in REQ-078; and (b) Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline mounts it behind Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline, so implementing the route is not sufficient -- it would still demand the token the caller cannot have. Resolve (b) explicitly: either an unauthenticated variant mounted ahead of AuthPipeline, or a documented exemption inside it. Pick one and record why in the moduledoc. This is the gate for the entire mobile tier -- without it the app cannot reach a login screen -- which is why it is sequenced first in docs/mobile/build-order.md phase M-0. Security scope: an unauthenticated endpoint returning per-tenant data is a tenant-data path by definition and needs SECURITY-REVIEWER. The response must expose only what bootstrap requires. Check the shape field-by-field against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md -- in particular whether an unauthenticated caller enumerating slugs can learn which tenants exist, and what the answer should be for a slug that does not exist.

result.summary: scripts/test_parallel.sh run twice. Attempt 1 (N=16, nproc default): 14/16 partitions crashed at mix ecto.migrate with DBConnection.ConnectionError (connection-pool exhaustion from 16 concurrent migration bursts against max_connections=100) -- 0 tests run in those partitions, discarded as inconclusive, not a code failure. Attempt 2 (N=6, TEST_PARALLEL_N env override, avoids the burst): all 6 partitions completed with real Result: lines -- combined 1765 tests, 5 properties, 4 failures (1766/1770 passed). Of the 4 failures: (1) test/letflow/identity_test.exs:807 (this branch's own new test, REQ-124 AC5) asserts assert_raise Ecto.QueryError but the vendored Ecto (3.14.1) actually raises Ecto.Query.CastError for the same bad input -- a wrong exception-class assumption in the test, not an app bug (safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2's bare rescue still correctly swallows it; the companion wrapped-call test passes). REWORK needed. (2)-(4) 3 failures in test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs (H6 fixture wrongly classified as hard_grandfathered instead of hard_new) -- confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to REQ-124: neither the test file nor lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex appears in git diff --name-only main...HEAD, AND reproduced identically (same 3 tests, same assertions) at merge-base e5cce4794524401e77e7993a2cd3027c03feb8d1 via an isolated git worktree. Root cause diagnosed: ISS-0262's @h6_floor_commit resolves dynamically via git merge-base HEAD origin/main every run, and as main has advanced past the fixture file's own commit, pre_floor_file?/2 now misclassifies it as grandfathered. No existing issue record covers this specific symptom (checked ISS-0262, ISS-0266) -- new finding, reported for filing, not fixed here (out of TEST-RUNNER ownership and out of REQ-124 scope). Full attribution and quoted output in test/reports/report-20260822-WF02-REQ124-20260822.yaml.
